history.content: Am I on track this week?

Here's what I actually checked: your calendar for this week. It shows a light, manageable load, BigCo interview today (Mon) at 2 PM, gym tonight at 6:30, dentist Tuesday 9 AM, team standup Wednesday 9:15, dinner with Dana Wednesday 7:30. No overlaps or collisions in there. What I haven't checked, named as such: your mail for anything owed or new instructions, your reminders, and any spending or habit logs, "on track" against goals I don't have a record of, since there's no active plan on file. If you tell me what "on track" means for you this week (a deadline, a budget, a habit streak), I'll pull the matching source and give you a real verdict.
